decision: No adoption. Dynamic exit improved selected historical win rates but failed matched timing controls and synthetic profitability/DD. R4 early pullback not yet independently falsified; no integrated portfolio BT.

protocol.entry_definition: R3 base BTC12 negative; continuation additionally >=60% of >=8 observed peer alts D12 bearish, 24h directional efficiency >=0.20 downward, asset underperformance vs BTC in both 6h halves, distance from trailing 168h low >=0.5 ATR, last close no more than 1.5 ATR below preceding 6h mean; early pullback independent H1 signal: same continuation context + previous 6h rebound from low >=0.75ATR, last bearish H1 closes below prior 3 H1 lows but above prior 12h low; 12h same-symbol signal refractory; closed H1 only.
protocol.exit_definition: hard STOP8 first, gap adverse. EARLY_INVALIDATION: 5% price stop or at completed H1 close after >=3h if net raw loss and two consecutive higher closes and latest close > prior 6h mean. TRAIL48: after >=2% favorable excursion, causal trailing stop 1.5% above minimum completed M5 low, never above STOP8; at 24h extend to max48h only if last completed 6 H1 closes net declining and gross profit>0.3%; COMBINED both. For trail use prior bar only, stop before updating low.
protocol.limitations: Known PRE TARGET FORWARD; exploratory, no funding; fixed protocol before computing; same wallet; no LIVE. Diagnostic MFE MAE excludes ambiguous STOP bar, includes actual exit price.

protocol.correction: Check scheduled invalidation at M5 open before intrabar high, except opening gap through active stop. Do not inspect current high before deciding open exit. Same thresholds.
protocol.random_control: R3 BTC12 all matched candidates with +/-1,3,6,9,12h same-symbol D126 BTC12 QA, 32 fixed draws seed 2026112704, same dynamic exit/wallet; no independent-market inference
protocol.synthetic: 6 previously defined scenario types, 1 new fixed seed per regime 2026112705, no optimization; same R2 generator, fixed24 versus trail48 R3 BTC12, independent simulated paths not empirical OOS
